items.hed: Texans are on their bye after hosting the Giants

items.hed: Astros active roster still lists Altuve, Alvarez, Peña, and Imai
items.insight: MLB.com's Houston active roster, read this morning, still lists Jose Altuve, Jeremy Peña, Yordan Alvarez, and pitcher Tatsuya Imai, with Josh Hader and Hunter Brown among the pitchers. It is an offseason list, not a game. No newer transaction was on the page.
